known.summary: `toggleOpenAiFast` turns fast mode off for every tier other than `none`, not only for `priority`. A deployed config with `tier.openai: ultrafast`, or any other tier, so switches to `none`, but the doc comment says that only `priority` counts as on and that any other tier switches to plain fast (`priority`). `docks-kit omp --fast` then turns fast mode off for a user who asked to turn it on. The pull request adds ompFastMode.ts: the base has no such file and no fast toggle.
